# provisioned

A fixture resource floe: mints a value and writes a local file.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| publishKey | null or string | `null` | Key the generated credential is published under, or null to generate it and let it stay in state.  This is the join between resources and bundles and the easiest thing in the design to get wrong. *Which* store is resolved — `optional.labStore` — so only the key is written here, and a cluster reads it back by resolving the same store.  |
| stateDir | string | `"/tmp/catallaxy-provisioned"` | Directory the `local` resources write into.  A real resource would name a cloud account here. This names a path, because the point of the fixture is the machinery around the resource rather than the resource.  |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | [KUBERNETES_CLUSTER](../signatures/KUBERNETES_CLUSTER.md) | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |

## Requires, optionally

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| labStore | [LAB_SECRET_STORE](../signatures/LAB_SECRET_STORE.md) | A store on the operator's machine that `cata` reads authored secret values from. |

## Emits

| alias | kind | what it carries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| publications | catallaxy.publications | Where a resource's output lands once it exists, as an address in a lab secret store. |
| resources | catallaxy.resources | Infrastructure declared for a state-based tool to create, for the case no cluster can own it. |
